creation_gate.shortest_normal_path: one Opus relationship reviewer jointly reads seven fixed inputs, decides once, and returns one structured review
creation_gate.observed_error_path: the successful C02 development run used 18 fixture-tool accesses for seven fixed input classes and accumulated 30 usage records
creation_gate.existing_boundary_insufficient: the parent fixes required inputs but leaves read scheduling, reread admission, and the decision boundary between results unspecified
creation_gate.replaced_predicate: issue all known independent required reads in the first tool-use step and admit an additional read only when its result can bind a specifically unobserved review judgment
creation_gate.removed_decision_points: intermediate judgment after each independent read and confirmation-only rereads after a review field is bound
creation_gate.new_decision_points: one post-wave decision plus an exception decision for missing, unreadable, or concretely contradictory evidence
creation_gate.quality_check: PRR-C02/r2 development benchmark retains the Finding Admission r1 quality contract
creation_gate.mechanism_check: the first fixture-tool batch contains the seven required reads and no additional fixture read occurs on the fixed complete packet
creation_gate.stop_condition: stop after the fixed C02 repetition if measurement or mechanism evidence is incomplete; do not claim C147 effect transfer or held-out generalization

control_source.transfer: target-specific translation of consumer-bound evidence and joint issuance; not a copy and not an effect claim

fixed: Finding Admission r1 final finding predicate
same Case, model-visible inputs, permissions, rating, and three KPI measurement
non_goals: fresh held-out effect, generalization, adoption, release, or runtime projection
